Hyundai introduces assured buyback for CRETA Electric The buyback program for the CRETA Electric, ensures 60% value retention after three years to boost EV adoption By PTI Updated - August 04, 2026 at 04:25 PM thehindubusinessline com/companies/hyundai-introduces-assured-buyback-for-creta-electric/article71304810 ece Hyundai Motor India Ltd (HMIL) on Tuesday introduced an assured buyback program for its CRETA Electric, offering customers 60 per cent assured buyback value till three years or up to 45,000 km Commenting on the introduction, HMIL MD & CEO Tarun Garg said the next phase of electric vehicle adoption in India will be driven equally by advancements in vehicle technology and by greater customer confidence. 이 기사는 해당 기업과 연결된 해외 보도를 바탕으로 정리했다.

matched_articles.title: China’s CXMT narrows gap with SK Hynix and Samsung in smartphone memory
matched_articles.summary: SK hynix 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'China’s CXMT narrows gap with SK Hynix and Samsung in smartphone memory'이다. The chipmaker completed a blockbuster initial public offering in Shanghai in July. PHOTO: REUTERS Published Aug 04, 2026, 05:52 PM Updated Aug 04, 2026, 06:14 PM CXMT is close to producing advanced smartphone memory chips comparable to top industry players like SK Hynix and Samsung, marking progress in China's tech self-sufficiency It plans to start small-scale production of sixth-generation low-power double-data-rate memory chips by year-end, aiming to address global chip shortages affecting major brands including Apple A road map to mass production of mobile memory chips would allow CXMT to compete with the likes of Micron Technology, SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics and take advantage of a global shortage that has become one of the biggest bottlenecks for top consumer electronics brands, including Apple SK Hynix introduced its 16 GB LPDDR6 chip in March, saying it is 33 per cent faster and 20 per cent more power-efficient than LPDDR5X Samsung also announced it has a similar product in its pipeline. 이 기사는 해당 기업과 연결된 해외 보도를 바탕으로 정리했다.
